d:
kumar
Bihar ke navada jile ke nagar thana kshetr sthit purani bajar (thakurbari ke nikat) se ek dil dahla dene vala mamla samne aaya hai. vyavsayi subodh kumar pichhle ek saptah se rahasyamay paristhitiyon men lapta hain. parijnon ke anusar, ve rat karib 8:15 baje ghar pahunche the aur dukan ki chabi-thaila rakhkar "15 minat men vapas aa raha hun" kahkar nikle the, lekin uske bad se ve vapas nahin laute.
